annotations.title: Change a new-post automation (can raise what it spends)

description: Change a new-post automation's settings (kind feed) while it runs, as PATCH /api/v1/automations/{id} takes them: each post's amount — quantity, or quantity_min + quantity_max (each post gets a random whole number in the range, within one delivery of the service) —, spread_minutes (30–360; 0 = all at once) + parts (2–10: each post's order in parts at random times within the window, each part at least the service's minimum, fewer parts for a small amount), delay_min_minutes + delay_max_minutes (the first part a random number of minutes after the post), posts (the next N posts), max_per_day and budget. Changes apply to posts found from now on; parts already planned keep their plan. Never charged above the price the plan promised. Call first without confirm: you get the settings in words and what they can cost. Tell the user. When they can cost more than its limit (change.budget.raise), the user must agree to the higher limit: then call with confirm: true and settings.confirm_budget: true (or a budget the user chose). Errors: not_editable (another kind, or it has ended), bad_quantity (outside one delivery of the service), bad_automation / bad_schedule (the message says what to change), confirm_budget (the limit would rise without the user's yes).

automation.description: The automation number (the `id` of an automation, e.g. 2001).

confirm.description: Must be true to actually change it. Only after the user agreed to the new settings and what they can cost.
